office_does: The coroner has jurisdiction over sudden, unexplained, violent or suspicious deaths in Grant County, including cases needing an autopsy or inquest.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Craig Morrison (Prefers Republican Party), coroner since November 2010, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Grant County Coroner since 2010 and a death-care professional for 43 years; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Says the office earned international accreditation and medicolegal death-investigator certifications during his tenure [S1]
Executive board member of the Washington Association of Coroners and Medical Examiners [S1]
